semantics.evidence: problem.txt: Mealy FSM, one-hot encoding, asynchronous active-high reset into A, sequential logic on positive clock edge
semantics.output: Combinational: in A z=x; in B z=~x. No registered output or extra latency.
semantics.reset: posedge areset immediately selects A; held reset selects A at each posedge clk. Output remains x in reset state A.
semantics.initialization: No specified state before reset; no power-up initialization added.
semantics.sampling: Transition uses x at posedge clk; after state settles, z reflects the new state and current x.

numeric.arithmetic: bitwise complement only; no rounding or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent seen-one history model based on original transition/output table
verification.coverage: both inputs in each state, pre/post edge outputs, between-edge x changes, asynchronous reset from B, held reset, reset release, exhaustive eight-bit streams

specification_ambiguities: Pre-reset and illegal-state behavior are unspecified; functional checks begin after reset and do not constrain illegal states.
